test_S3Observer_started_event: test the S3Observer started_event to verify it creates an S3 bucket and writes config.json and run.json
test_S3Observer_completed_event: test the S3Observer completed_event to verify it updates run.json status to COMPLETED
test_S3Observer_failed_event: test the S3Observer failed_event to verify it updates run.json status to FAILED with an error message
test_S3Observer_artifact_event: test the S3Observer artifact_event to verify it uploads artifact files to the S3 run directory
test_S3Observer_equality: test the S3Observer equality comparison to verify observers with the same bucket and basedir are equal
